user_query: I'm organizing a charity event and we want to provide multilingual support. Can you provide me with the supported languages list for the AI Translation APIs? Additionally, check the Tribal Mail Translate API to ensure we have enough translation allowance to communicate with participants in their preferred languages.

TaskList.description: Query the AI Translation API to retrieve the list of supported languages for multilingual translations.
Check the Tribal Mail Translate API to verify the translation allowance for the event.
